comparison.objective: Snap a parallel link onto the closure branch that leaves a robot wrist level; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose a kinematic closure branch and snap one eye over a pin versus orient and support a long handed rail, latch it at two posts, extend it, and screw it down.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a snapped tongue and level wrist without disturbing the braked arm; candidate requires correct side/orientation, matched rack units, complete prong engagement, screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: A spring snap is shared, but the record tests linkage topology; the candidate tests distributed structural installation.
